request: API p99 latency rose from 180 ms to 900 ms on 12 September. We upgraded the database on 11 September and changed some feature flags on 12 September. What caused it?
known_answer: The 12 September flag audit_log_sync=true in eu-west makes each request write its audit record to object storage before responding; only eu-west p99 rose. The 11 September database upgrade touched all regions and their latency did not change.
decoy_answer: The Postgres 15.8 upgrade on 11 September made queries slower, which raised API latency.
source: synthetic: the cause is fixed by construction in this task's files; no real system or client

new_nav: navigation redesign.
search_boost: ranking weight.
